dice.contest: * {actor} and {target} roll against each other: {actor} [{rolled}], {target} [{against}]. {winner} wins.
dice.usage: Can't roll that. Use d6, d10, d20 or d100, for example /roll 1d20+2d6 (up to {max} dice).
dice.too_many: Too many dice: up to {max} a roll.
dice.no_modifiers: Modifiers like +3 are not rolled yet. Use d6, d10, d20 or d100, for example /roll 1d20+2d6.
dice.unknown_set: There is no dice set "{set}". The sets: {list}.
dice.your_set: Your dice set: {set}. The sets: {list}. Pick one with /dice <set>.
dice.cmd.roll: /roll [dice] - roll d6, d10, d20 or d100 for those around, for example /roll, /roll 2d6 or /roll 1d20+2d6 (up to 5 dice); with the board open, the dice land on it
dice.cmd.board: /board - open or close the dice board (Home)
dice.cmd.dice: /dice [set] - show or pick your dice set
